headline: Removing prevent_destroy from production data bucket to work around a CI issue — fix the CI issue instead
suppressed: Adding the CostCenter tag is unremarkable.

findings.evidence_ref: Removal of `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` block in data_stores.tf
findings.explanation: The lifecycle guard prevents accidental destruction of a production data bucket. Removing it as a workaround to unblock CI leaves acme-prod-data vulnerable to deletion by any future terraform apply or destroy. The right fix is to resolve why the guard is causing CI failures, not to remove the guard.
